PRIVACY POLICY

Confidentiality and security are fundamental values of Illa Llinares Senon. We therefore undertake to guarantee the User’s privacy at all times and not to collect unnecessary information. Below, we provide all the necessary information about our Privacy Policy in relation to the personal data we collect, explaining:

  • Who is responsible for processing your data.
  • The purposes for which we collect the data we request from you.
  • The legal basis for processing your data.
  • How long we retain your data.
  • The recipients to whom your data is disclosed.
  • Your rights and how to exercise them.

1. DATA CONTROLLER:

Illa Llinares Senon

C/ Sèquia de Mestalla, 28F 46110, Godella (VALENCIA)

legal@illallinares.com

2. PURPOSES, LEGAL BASIS AND RETENTION FOR PROCESSING DATA SUBMITTED THROUGH:

Contact form.

  • Purpose: To provide a way for you to contact us and to respond to your requests for information, and to send you communications about our products, services and activities, including by electronic means (email, SMS, etc.), if you tick the acceptance box.
  • Legal basis: The user’s consent when requesting information through our contact form and when ticking the box accepting the sending of information.
  • Retention: Once your request has been resolved through our form or answered by email, provided it has not resulted in further processing; if you have agreed to receive commercial communications, until you request to unsubscribe.

Sending emails.

  • Purpose: To respond to your requests for information, attend to your requests and answer your enquiries or questions. If we receive your curriculum vitae, your personal and CV data may be included in our databases to participate in current and future recruitment processes.
  • Legal basis: The user’s consent when requesting information through the email address or sending us their data and CV to participate in our recruitment processes.
  • Retention: Once your email request has been answered, provided it has not resulted in further processing. If we receive your CV, your data may be retained for a maximum of one year for future recruitment processes.

Obligation to provide your personal data and consequences of not doing so.

Providing personal data requires a minimum age of 18 years and sufficient legal capacity to enter into contracts.

The personal data requested is necessary to manage your requests, register you as a user and/or provide services you may contract. If you do not provide it, we will be unable to attend to you properly or provide the service you have requested.

In all cases, we reserve the right to decide whether to include your personal data and other information in our databases.

3. RECIPIENTS OF YOUR DATA.

Your data is confidential and will not be disclosed to third parties unless there is a legal obligation to do so.

4. COOKIES

This website only uses cookies that enable its operation and the provision of the services offered on it and, where applicable, first-party cookies solely to measure its audience, which are therefore considered exempt from consent. Accordingly, under Article 22 of the Spanish Law on Information Society Services, your consent is not required for their installation.

On this website, local storage is used exclusively to remember the language selected by the user. No analytics or advertising tools are used. This preference can be removed by clearing the website’s data in your browser. External services accessed through links, such as the booking calendar, WhatsApp or LinkedIn, are governed by their own policies.

5. RIGHTS RELATING TO YOUR PERSONAL DATA.

Anyone may withdraw their consent at any time where it has been given for processing their data. Under no circumstances does withdrawing consent affect the performance of the subscription contract or relationships established previously.

You may also exercise the following rights:

  • Request access to your personal data or correction of inaccurate data.
  • Request its deletion when, among other reasons, the data is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected.
  • Request restriction of its processing in certain circumstances.
  • Object to its processing for reasons relating to your particular situation.
  • Request data portability in the cases provided for by law.
  • Other rights recognised by applicable regulations.

Where and how to exercise your rights: By submitting a written request to the data controller at the postal or email address indicated in section 1, using the reference “Personal Data”, specifying the right you wish to exercise and the personal data concerned.

If you disagree with the company regarding the processing of your data, you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.agpd.es).

6. SECURITY OF YOUR PERSONAL DATA

To safeguard the security of your personal data, we inform you that we have adopted all necessary technical and organisational measures to protect the personal data provided against alteration, loss and unauthorised processing or access.

7. UPDATING YOUR DATA

To enable us to keep your personal data up to date, it is important that you always inform us of any changes. Otherwise, we accept no responsibility for its accuracy.

We are not responsible for the privacy policy concerning personal data you may provide to third parties through links available on our website.

This Privacy Policy was updated on 14/10/2026 and may be amended to reflect changes to our website or legislative or case-law developments concerning personal data. You should therefore read it each time you provide us with your data through this website.
